digest.component_or_area: local developer gates (rebar review-plan, review-code, verify-completion)
propositions: Local rebar gates must resolve model classes to Bedrock inference profiles and execute end-to-end with parseable verdicts and valid structured output on real tickets.
All local gate calls must route through Bedrock inference profiles with zero direct Anthropic calls, verifiable from the usage log per-call tally.
Prompt caching must engage on the Bedrock path with nonzero cache_read_tokens across multiple gate runs, not write-only behavior.
The Bedrock cachePoint TTL default matches Anthropic cache_control default (5 minutes) with no observable behavioral difference when no explicit TTL is set.
Developer opt-in via layered config file (REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE) and revert to Anthropic must both be documented and executable in one step.
No infra/ modifications are permitted; changes are local configuration and documentation only.
